subject: Data Engineering
title: Offset Management
description: A short lesson to help you apply Offset Management.

hook.text: A consumer restarts after a crash. Where does it resume? From the beginning? The end? The last checkpoint?

buildup.text: Offsets track the consumer's position in a stream — which events have been read and processed.

discovery.text: Committing offsets after processing means a crash replays only unprocessed events, not the entire stream.

twist.text: If offsets commit before processing finishes, a crash means events are skipped. After? Duplicates on replay.

climax.text: Offset management is the mechanism behind delivery guarantees. Get it wrong and data is lost or duplicated.

punchline.text: Your place in the stream is everything. Track it carefully.

quiz.question: What happens if offsets are committed before event processing completes?
options: A crash can cause events to be skipped
The stream pauses until processing finishes
